description: Deterministic FactLot ID for a legal entity (LLC, LP, corporation, trust) from its registry jurisdiction and file number, or from its LEI (an LEI whose ISO 17442 check digits do not match is rejected).

jurisdiction.description: Registry jurisdiction, e.g. "us-de" for Delaware, or "lei" for a Legal Entity Identifier.

registry_number.description: File number issued by that registry, or the 20-character LEI (its ISO 17442 check digits are verified).

name: id_entity
title: FactLot legal-entity ID
